message.content:
Colorado City uses 40% of the water from the Colorado River. Out of this 40%, 80% is used for industrial purposes, so the remaining 20% is used for non-industrial purposes. To find the percentage of the river's total water used for non-industrial purposes, we calculate 20% of 40%. 

$$
0.20 \times 40 = 8
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 8
